name: Gemini 305
summary: Gemini 305 is a compact USB-C stereo camera designed for mounting on robot wrists. Its 18 mm baseline and short minimum range support close-range recognition, grasping and manipulation. Global-shutter color sensors provide depth-plus-color or dual-color modes, with hardware and software synchronization for multi-camera systems.

description.en: Gemini 305 is a compact USB-C stereo camera designed for mounting on robot wrists. Its 18 mm baseline and short minimum range support close-range recognition, grasping and manipulation. Global-shutter color sensors provide depth-plus-color or dual-color modes, with hardware and software synchronization for multi-camera systems.

sources.title: CES 2026: Gemini 305 & 345Lg with Jetson Thor
sources.quote: Las Vegas, January 6, 2026 — Orbbec unveiled two breakthrough products at CES 2026, advancing the future of robotic vision: the Gemini 305, an ultra-compact stereo 3D camera engineered specifically for robotic wrist mounting, and the Gemini 345Lg, a rugged stereo vision camera built to thrive in demanding environments. The company simultaneously announced full platform compatibility between its flagship Gemini series cameras and NVIDIA Jetson Thor , while unveiling its dual manufacturing capabilities spanning Shunde, China and Vietnam—marking a comprehensive upgrade in both R&D and manufacturing prowess within the robotics vision sector.
